reviews.title: Very Disappointing Product and Refund Experience
reviews.text:
I bought this product because I thought it might help with my anxiety. I tried one of the solutions and experienced extremely disturbing nightmares that night. I am not someone who normally has nightmares, so this was a very unusual and unpleasant experience for me.

I requested a refund within 24 hours of purchasing it, but Apple refused. My understanding is that UK consumer law provides a 14-day cancellation period for many online purchases, including digital content, subject to certain exceptions and conditions.

Given how quickly I contacted Apple and the unexpected reaction I experienced after using the product, I was very disappointed that they refused my refund request.

Unfortunately, I am not satisfied with the product or with the way Apple handled my request.

reviews.text:
TLDR: used to be free and good, then required to pay for the app to keep using it, now requiring a monthly subscription to keep using it even though I previously paid. Time to find a new app. 

I've had this app for a long time, since before it had its current name. I don't use all of the "fancy" features but I do have a custom mix of multiple different water sounds (rain, stream, waterfall, etc). A while back they put a lot of the sounds I used behind a pay wall, or possibly, even the ability to use the app at all. I forget exactly. It was a free app and then they made it like $1.99 or something like that. I paid for it just for the convenience of keeping my mix. Up until two nights ago, everything was fine. Last night I went to play my mix and only 1 of my 5 sounds would play. It is now forcing me to pay a subscription of $1.99/mo to use my sounds and upon further looking, it appears most of the sounds in the app are now behind the subscription. Remember, I paid for this app. Now I have to pay a subscription to keep using it? No thanks. Time to find a better app. Thanks for screwing over customers that already paid to use your app.
